symptom: describe → exec of a snippet turns its Type 'Web' into '' (and would reset a non-default ExportLevel or canvas size)
cause: snippetToGen wrote Type, ExportLevel, CanvasWidth and CanvasHeight as constants on every write; the Type constant was ""
insight: The snippet twin of #541 (carryStoredPageHeader). "" is not a member of PagesType (Native | Web), so every snippet mxcli created was also invalid. Carry the stored header on UpdateSnippet (width-agnostic canvas read — Studio Pro stores int64); a new snippet gets Web/Hidden/800×600, measured on all four Blank-template snippets
